scope: registry-backed persistent IPK lifecycle and explicit recovery for generic-mips and generic-mipsel, preserving generic-aarch64; E06-E08 and MVP 1D D02/D07 are separate

per_target_observations.successful_lifecycle: real target opkg installs a locked native-architecture IPK, runs postinst once, executes hello, and retains its full-ID container across restart and down/up; status, ports, logs, exec, destroy and permanent tombstone checked
per_target_observations.service: SHA-256-pinned target-native web-demo installed as IPK; target-loopback HTTP readiness passed after create, same-ID restart, and down/up while postinst count stayed one
per_target_observations.negative_input: wrong-architecture static inspection and changed locked source refused before registry/Docker allocation
per_target_observations.negative_install: failed postinst leaves failed registry state and owner-verified absent container, explicit recovery tombstones
per_target_observations.interruption: real creator SIGKILL after Docker create before ID publication and after ID publication/start; registry remains creating/installing, no automatic replay, explicit CLI recovery removes sole exact-name/full-ID resource and idempotent retry returns tombstone
per_target_observations.foreign_resource: stale registry pointing to a different run full ID refused; extra same-run container and different-target/image same-run container refused without removing the original; injected remove failure retains transitional state and succeeds on exact retry
per_target_observations.concurrency: existing cross-process per-name flock and atomic transition/replacement tests passed; live creator lock held at both interruption barriers
per_target_observations.postflight: both live target cases independently compared full Docker container and network ID sets before/after; final owner-label container/network queries empty

limitations: Recovery is explicit only and discards uncertain state; it does not replay postinst or infer an interrupted PASS/report
No E06 standalone or persistent script integration, E07 three-target adversarial acceptance, or E08 final audit is claimed
MVP 1D D02/D07 same-UID target cleanup race and interrupted script-artifact/report blockers remain unchanged
No host binfmt, module, firewall or foreign resource mutation
